cases.prompt: 앱의 월간·연간 구독 상품 ID와 그룹, 국가별 가격 초안을 만들어줘.

assertions.text: Produces unique product IDs, subscription grouping and upgrade/downgrade paths with unresolved choices labeled.
Does not invent live store price tiers or exchange rates; verifies current official values before finalizing.

cases.prompt: App Store Connect와 Play Console에 지금 상품을 등록해줘.

assertions.text: Keeps console registration separate from manifest preparation and obtains exact approval before live paid-product changes.
Includes a sandbox purchase and restoration test checklist.
